sub_sector.value: life science research instruments and reagents; diagnostic testing kits; preclinical CRO services

manufacturing_type.detail: Instruments built as units; reagents, antibodies, assay kits produced in batches.

production_model.detail: Catalog instruments, reagents and kits sold online; contract services and viral vector manufacture done to order.

product_complexity.detail: High-content imaging systems, automated cytometers, and sensitive diagnostic assays for research and clinical use.

production_role.detail: Sells finished instruments, reagents and tests to labs; also offers contract research and viral vector manufacturing.

end_market_exposure.detail: Pharma, biotech, academia, CROs, CDMOs, and clinical diagnostics including newborn screening and infectious disease testing.
